Connect the leading data and marketing platforms to Amplitude. Don’t see what you need? We can integrate with any system.
We got on for the generous free plan, stayed for the simple UX. Amplitude has been the only analytics product that we've gotten the whole team using (operators, engineers, designers, product).
I visited their website, could not understand what it does or solves, left. Looks like bloated soft.

Amplitude is NOT a great product when you actually try to implement it. I have seen at least 3 companies pay for them... only to realize that the integration is actually very hard, and the data in Amplitude is often wrong! Also they dont do a good job in sending data back to things like SFDC.

It seemed critical early on that Amplitude basically made what MixPanel charged a lot for free, by providing a huge free tier. This is how my company ended up on Amplitude... and then we didn't pay for years, until we eventually ended up paying $40K/year then more.
We are still small and well within the free tier, your service is incredibly valuable to early startups and I look forward to returning the generosity as we grow.
